predecessors.name: Hassuna culture
predecessors.text: Tell Shemshara and Yarim Tepe, sites of both cultures

successors.name: Ubaid period
successors.text: the middle Tigris around Samarra and Tell es-Sawwan ("middle Tigris, near Samarra"; "110 kilometres (68 mi) north of Baghdad, and south of Samarra") and the Rania plain of Tell Shemshara

ledger.x: 5500 BCE: the irrigation farmers of Samarra settle the middle Tigris.
4800 BCE: the Samarra gives way to the Ubaid.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture: two radii around excavated sites, never a frontier.
